arrays: Retain authoritative array order and repetitions. Never sort or deduplicate artifact identities.

integers: chainId, collectionId and tokenId are exact uint256 decimal strings without leading zeros. scopeType is an integer JSON number0..4. This version contains no floating-point fields.
keys: Emit the exact schema keys in ascending UTF-16 order; all keys in this version are ASCII. Do not emit whitespace.

rule: RFC8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme restricted to the typed 6529STREAM_ARTIST_SANCTION_CEREMONY_V1 schema.
strings: Validate UTF-8 and preserve Unicode scalar values without normalization. Escape quote and backslash; use the short JSON escapes for backspace, tab, newline, form feed and carriage return, and lowercase \u00xx for other U+0000..U+001F controls. Do not escape slash or other characters. Reject invalid UTF-8, overlong forms, surrogates and values above U+10FFFF.
